description: Run or re-run official Uwear QA on existing generation results. Every image generate/edit result already gets a free AI check after delivery, so when the user asks to QA, quality check, validate, review or inspect results, first call read_generation_result_qa and use the existing check (ai_qa). Call this tool only when needed: the user wants approve/reject set by QA (mode gate), or the check could not run (ai_qa.can_recheck true: use mode observe). Do not substitute view_image for QA unless the user explicitly asks for a manual visual critique instead of the official Uwear QA pipeline. After queuing, call read_generation_result_qa for the same IDs. QA is free. QA is built for scale — validating large batches (hundreds or thousands of results). When the user is iterating on a handful of results one by one, do not queue QA on your own initiative; run it when the user asks for it or when operating at batch scale.

inputSchema.description: Input schema for queueing QA on existing generation results.

generation_result_ids.description: Generation result IDs to QA. QA is free.

max_qa_retries.description: Maximum QA-triggered retry generations to allow. Retry generations can cost additional generation credits.

mode.description: gate (default): official QA that sets approve/reject and may retry. observe: only re-run the free AI check when it could not run (ai_qa.can_recheck); it never sets a decision and never retries.

name: queue_generation_result_qa
title: Run QA on Results
